# SkePU Documentation {#sec-documentation}
This chapter gives short and concise descriptions for each of the functions that each SkePU skeleton has along with an example for each of them.

## Shared between skeletons

### `setBackend(BackendSpec)`
Sets the backend that the skeleton instance will be executed on. Overrides any global configuration to the backend, e.g. via `setGlobalBackendSpec(BackendSpec)`.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    auto vsum = skepu::Map(sum);
    
    skepu::BackendSpec spec{"openmp"};

    vsum.setBackend(spec);
}
```
